subject: Computer science
title: In one company's data, students' AI conversations were not spread across fields like their degrees
source: Source: Handa et al. (2025), Anthropic Education Report (Apr 8, 2025): 574,740 conversations from accounts with higher-education email addresses, one 18-day window; degree shares from NCES U.S. bachelor's degrees. The report's introduction gives 36.8% for computer science; its body and chart give 38.6%.
